<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/organization/model_cost_overrides"}
#docs
It starts now or later and never reaches back over usage that is already costed. To change a cost, end the current row and add a new one. The model can be one the list does not have. Needs `model_prices:manage`.

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `string` | no | Null = this model under any provider. |
| `model` | `string` | **yes** | The model id or name, as your events send it. |
| `token_type` | `string` | **yes** | The model cost override's token type. |
| `currency` | `string` | **yes** | The model cost override's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `unit_amount_decimal` | `string` | **yes** | Minor units (cents for USD) per `quantity_divisor` units. A decimal string with at most 12 decimal places and no exponent, for example `"0.25"`. |
| `quantity_divisor` | `integer | string` | **yes** | Units the amount is for: 1000000 (per 1M), 1000 (per 1K) or 1. |
| `effective_from` | `string · ISO-8601` | no | Now or later. Default now. |
| `effective_to` | `string · ISO-8601` | no | The model cost override's effective to. |
| `note` | `string` | no | A note about the model cost override. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `model_cost_override`. One of `model_cost_override`. |
| `id` | `string` | The model cost override's id. |
| `provider` | `string` | Null = this model under any provider. |
| `model` | `string` | The model id or name, as your events send it. |
| `token_type` | `string` | The model cost override's token type. |
| `currency` | `string` | The model cost override's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `unit_amount_decimal` | `string` | Minor units (cents for USD) per `quantity_divisor` units. A decimal string with at most 12 decimal places and no exponent, for example `"0.25"`. |
| `quantity_divisor` | `integer` | The model cost override's quantity divisor. |
| `effective_from` | `string · ISO-8601` | The model cost override's effective from. |
| `effective_to` | `string · ISO-8601` | The model cost override's effective to. |
| `note` | `string` | A note about the model cost override. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the model cost override was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `deleted` | `boolean` | Present and true on a delete response. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | The cost row. |
| `400` | The body is not correct, or `effective_from` is in the past. |
| `409` | Another cost for this key is in effect in that period. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/organization/model_cost_overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "flat",
    "token_type": "input",
    "currency": "USD",
    "unit_amount_decimal": "200",
    "quantity_divisor": 1
  }'
```
